items.why: Новый интерфейс бессмысленен, пока базовые переходы теряют состояние.

solution.choice: Main derives Scope from registered webContents/window project selection or validated AgentSurface credential. A caller-provided estate/project is a requested object selector, never authority. Introduce scoped repository interfaces so schedulers cannot receive naked SupabaseClient. Keep local operator identity explicit; do not claim this completes authentication/team roles.
transactions: For every command, re-read parent project/task/agent/session/repo membership under one scoped transaction; compare estate and project on all related IDs. Add composite identities UNIQUE(estate_id,id), UNIQUE(estate_id,project_id,id) where required and composite FK on v2 relationships. No UUID-shaped binding is admitted solely because it exists.

Local trusted main can supply system actor only from hardcoded scheduler capability, not renderer input. Task/result writers check execution lease+binding revision inside guarded RPC. Read queries always carry estate predicate, plus project predicate for project scope; no array of foreign IDs assembled by unscoped preliminary query.
solution.filesystem: Per-window/per-project RootGrantSet, not global union. resolve(scope,root_ref,relative_path) resolves actual parent/target and enforces boundary at each operation. Native folder selection grants only that window/context; no widening other windows or agents. Existing realpath check protects static symlink escape but not an attacker replacing path components concurrently. Trusted-local profile may retain this stated limit; untrusted-repo profile requires dirfd/handle-relative no-follow opens or sandbox, and stays unadmitted until race fixture passes.
solution.p21: CI run34070268253 at5051def, /tmp/fabric-priority-remote-full.log:2107 service_role SELECT pass; :2108 anon effective SELECT grants on estate_settings/proposals/question_blocks/questions/routines/task_handoffs fail. These six have RLS/member policies in migrations25/27/28/29. Therefore ACL mismatch is confirmed, row leakage is not. Migration26 grants desired roles but never explicitly revokes anon SELECT. Do not assert which bootstrap default caused CI difference. CI uses latest CLI and pulled postgres17.6.1.165 (log1415); pin measured CLI/image independently.

Unauthorized object not found has same safe external result as absent object.
Scope credentials are not an OS sandbox; same-uid limitation CO090 remains explicit.

DB read fails → typed unavailable snapshot, never [] eligibility.

Revoke future anon defaults for postgres and actual migration owner; inspect inherited PUBLIC grants. Do not strip required service DML until its writer migrates to typed RPC.

Split P21 wording/assertions into ACL capability vs RLS visibility. Add a migration-created temporary table fixture for each relevant owner/default set. Pin CLI/image or retain manifest recording exact versions; older migration comments remain historical evidence, not current causal explanation.

Backfill ownership from authoritative parent rows; report dangling/cross-scope legacy rows into deterministic projection_anomalies before constraint validation. v1 replay must remain readable and cannot abort on the newly enforced v2-only guard.

items.title: Граница estate/project и файловых корней
items.why: Service role обходит RLS; scheduler сейчас может читать чужую работу.

solution: Move the estate/project predicate out of the call site: a table→scope map derived from the schema, and a client narrowed to one scope handed to every caller instead of the naked SupabaseClient. An unmapped table is refused rather than passed through.
Give the two projections that carried no owner one — goals and question_blocks — backfilled from the authoritative parent, with NOT NULL as the assertion rather than a silent drop.
interfaces: shared/scope.ts: Scope, TABLE_SCOPE, scopeFilters(table,scope), scopeOwnership(table,scope), withinScope(scope,projectId).
main/scopedStore.ts: createScopedStore(db,scope) with select/insert/update/delete and no escape hatch; projectStore(db,parent,projectId) refuses a project outside the parent scope.
invariants: Every projection read in the main process is narrowed to one estate, and to one project where the scope names one.
A table absent from the map raises rather than returning an unnarrowed builder.
Scope columns are written on insert, but never the row's own primary key.
tests: Two-directional map/schema parity; predicate shape per scope kind; a planted question blocking a foreign task; a block row written for a task it cannot block.
migration: Additive columns with parent backfill; the projector arm for goals is extracted to its own function rather than the monolith being rewritten.
failure_cases: Unknown table -> UnscopedTable naming the file to edit.
A read that lost its predicate -> the ratchet names file and line before merge.

solution: Replace the single global root set with per-window/per-project grants, so a folder chosen in one context does not widen another window or an agent.
Keep the trusted-local profile's stated limit explicit: realpath defeats a static symlink, not an attacker swapping a path component concurrently.
interfaces: main/files.ts: resolve(scope, rootRef, relativePath) enforcing the boundary at each operation rather than once at grant time.
root_grant projection {estate_id, project_id, window_context_id, root_ref, canonical_path, grant_revision, revoked_seq}.
invariants: A native folder selection grants that window only.
A revoked root refuses the next operation; an open editor does not retain authority.
tests: Two windows with a symlink from one root into the other; revoke while an editor is open; the component-swap race, which stays unadmitted until it passes.
migration: Grants become rows rather than a process-lifetime set; dialog grants may remain local config and must not become estate authority by accident.
failure_cases: Root revoked mid-edit -> refusal, not a stale write.
Untrusted-repo profile -> refused as unsupported rather than silently weaker.

solution: Revoke unintended anon/PUBLIC rights on app-owned tables explicitly, instead of relying on a default-privileges statement that only governs tables created afterwards.
Split the P21 assertion into ACL capability and RLS row visibility, because a passing grant check and an enforced policy are different claims and the log conflates them.
interfaces: An append-only ACL repair migration; P21 reporting privilege and visibility separately, each with its own positive control.
invariants: service role reads every app table; anon holds no SELECT privilege; an authenticated member sees their estate and not another's.
Granting anon SELECT inside a rolled-back fixture still yields zero rows, which is what proves RLS separately.
tests: Role matrix over an isolated migrated database; a temporary table per relevant owner/default set.
migration: Additive revocation; required service DML is not stripped before its writer moves to typed RPC.
failure_cases: A missing grant looks exactly like an empty table, which is the failure this repair exists to stop recurring.
CLI/image drift changes the inherited default; the manifest records the measured versions rather than asserting a cause.

solution.split: S03.boundary supplies shared per-command scope/floor/revision/grant reservation. S03.effects adds actual adapter dispatch, attempts, observations and unknown reconciliation. S04/S06 require boundary, not a finished external connector.
states: Grant: available → reserved(command_id) → consumed(at dispatch fence); available/reserved → revoked; expiry blocks new reservation/dispatch. Release reservation only with proof no dispatch occurred, by explicit command.

EffectIntent: proposed → reserved → dispatching → succeeded | failed_known | outcome_unknown. reserved → cancelled_before_dispatch. outcome_unknown is unresolved, not success; reconciliation creates new evidence and resolves it. Terminal result receipts immutable.
transactions: issueGrant preallocates grant UUID and appends grant.issued@2 with full scope/action/target/revision/expiry; projection built in same transaction. reserveEffect locks grant and effect command, checks DB now<expiry, revoked_at=null, project/action/target exact match, precondition/current revisions, all ceilings minimum and absolute floor; unique reservation grants at most one command. Refusal carries safe reason, never executed.

beginEffectDispatch checks current principal fence, policy revision, grant not revoked/expired, budget and reservation; records attempt + dispatch_started and consumes grant before releasing transaction. External call occurs only after commit. A one-shot grant authorizes the logical effect; adapter retries use same effect idempotency key, not a second consumption.

observeEffect requires trusted adapter/reconciler capability, matching attempt/provider effect ref and structured evidence; agent prose is a claim. Commit observed outcome + receipt atomically. Crash after effect but before receipt → unknown; lookup provider by same key/ref, never new key retry.

Release and beginDispatch take the same grant/reservation lock. Release succeeds only while every recorded attempt proves not dispatched; absence of a final receipt is not proof. The old intent retains reservation/grant lineage. A subsequent command acquires a new reservation UUID; concurrent new commands have one winner under the partial unique index.
solution.redaction: Replace free-text authority target with {resource_ref,operation,canonical_target_digest}; secret-bearing target input is refused, not normalized into a different permission. Human-readable why may be redacted with count receipt. Safe sink runs in Policy/command ingress, not only AgentSurface. Never persist raw OAuth/bearer/secret material in a trace.

tables: effect_intents_v2: command_id PK,estate_id,project_id,action_class,target_ref,target_digest,policy_revision,grant_id,reservation_epoch,state,last_receipt_seq; reservation_id FK; grant_id lineage is not globally unique across released reservations

effect_attempts: attempt_id PK,command_id,attempt_no,adapter_revision,idempotency_key,dispatch_started_seq,provider_effect_ref,status,observation_ref; UNIQUE(command_id,attempt_no); same target idempotency key across retries

grant_reservations: reservation_id PK, estate_id, grant_id, command_id, state:'reserved'|'consumed'|'released'|'revoked', revision, release_proof_ref, acquired_seq, released_seq; immutable lineage, event-derived status. UNIQUE(grant_id) WHERE state IN ('reserved','consumed','revoked'); released reservations keep their rows. revoked grant remains unusable regardless of uniqueness.
commands: EffectDispatch({effectCommandId,expectedEpoch}) → durable dispatch permit, no success claim

ReleaseGrantReservation({reservation_id,expected_revision,no_dispatch_proof_ref}) → canonical CommandResult<GrantReservation>. Lock reservation + grant + intent; require cancelled_before_dispatch and no possibly-dispatched attempt; append released receipt atomically. If grant expired/revoked keep it unusable; otherwise restore available. Consumed/unknown cannot release.

invariants: The DB floor validates matching live grant, not merely nonnull FK.
A permission receipt cannot produce effect.executed.
Revocation after dispatch does not erase or mislabel an already completed external effect.
Cooperative MCP alone remains trusted-local tier, not mandatory CLI interception/sandbox.
failure_cases: Reservation expiry/revoke between reserve and begin → no dispatch.
Timeout after provider acted → retain reservation/unknown, reconcile before replay.
Two grant requests from distinct projects/actions with same target → only exact granted scope succeeds.
migration: No historical journal rewrite. Existing grant.issued@1 lacks grant UUID and current direct row may be unjoinable: mark legacy_unverified, preserve records, do not automatically promote unspent legacy grants to v2 authority. Require explicit reissue with exact action/scope.

Existing effect.executed@1 produced by permission path is displayed as legacy claim/unverified unless independent evidence proves completion; add classification projection, not retroactive invented receipts.
Switch both operator and agent effect paths to shared v2 commands in same release; legacy generic writer rejects v2 guarded types; minimum compatible writer version prevents downgrade.

const body = result.body as Record<string, unknown>

solution.choice: Introduce startExistingTask; createTask and admitTaskLaunch are separate commands. Routine may create its own task once per unique cycle window, chain must launch the existing follower. Resolve actual runner through scoped binding before quota/admission. TaskRun is created after admission as an explicit logical invocation, never because a button was pressed or an unrelated predecessor completed.
states: AdmissionReceipt: refused or admitted; refused has no TaskRun.

TaskRun: admitted → launching → active → ending → ended; admitted/launching → ended(failed_start/cancelled_before_launch); active → ending(cancel_requested) → ended only on invocation/process evidence. ended is immutable. Outcome unknown is retained as uncertainty, not inferred success.

Task Board status stays backlog/review until agent acceptance; attached/launching is an execution indicator. On ack, task enters running; structured completed result submits review, never auto-done. Legacy delivery-unconfirmed displays live process beside unchanged task state.
transactions: admitTaskLaunch(scope, key, task, expected_task_rev, trigger): under estate lock validate scope, nonterminal task, allowed explicit transition, all open blockers, pinned graph links/needs, runner capability/profile, current role_slot_id/binding_revision/epoch, fresh provider/account quota snapshot, total budget reservation and no active TaskRun. solution.choice: Instrument transport + central tool dispatcher so read, mutation, schema refusal, thrown handler, retries and cancellation share one attempt identity. Business receipts remain their own events. Do not infer a tool-call count from domain events.

solution.choice: Question owns immutable revisioned subject/options; many-to-many blocking set is canonical. blocked_by remains only compatibility summary (earliest active blocker), never launch guard. Answer and decision fact are one typed command and transaction. Delivery uses committed continuation outbox; does not wait for full M188 steps.
states: Question open(revision) → answered(resolution_id) | withdrawn(reason) | stale(reason). Terminal resolution cannot overwrite; ask a new question for a new subject or revised decision.
Block relation active while its question open; resolution removes only that relation from active-set query. Task status remains its rung.
Continuation pending → addressed → delivered_unconfirmed | accepted | expired/superseded/unknown; independent from answer committed.
transactions: answerQuestion(scope,key,questionId,expectedRevision,answer,chosenOption,basis): lock question and sorted blocked tasks; validate scope, open status, about/subject revision, current option set, principal role and floor via S03.boundary. CEO/product-manager settlement checks current cite/trust/criticality in same command, never caller assertion.

Allocate decision_id/resolution_id once; append memory.project.recorded@2 and question.answered@2 plus block resolution and continuation-request events in one transaction. Use actual memory event vocabulary, not nonexistent memory.remembered. Commit receipt returns both references and remaining blockers per task. Crash rolls back all; duplicate key returns both same IDs.

Recompute active blockers by join questions.status=open; order asked_at then question id. Set blocked_by/blocked_since from earliest remaining, null only count=0. Wake/continuation outbox for newly unblocked task only after commit and only once per resolution/task; do not start task when another blocker exists.

schema: questions add revision,subject_revision,resolution_id,updated_seq; question_resolutions {resolution_id PK,question_id UNIQUE,command_id UNIQUE,decision_id UNIQUE,question_revision,actor_ref,basis_refs,answered_seq}
question_blocks add estate_id,project_id; PK(question_id,task_id), composite FK to same estate/project task+question; blocking set query/index(question_id,status)/(task_id,question_id)
continuations {continuation_id PK,source_resolution_id,task_id,source_task_run_id?,recipient_task_run_id?,delivery_id?,state}; UNIQUE(source_resolution_id,task_id)
commands: QuestionWithdraw({questionId,expectedRevision,reason}) → resolution receipt; does not invent a decision fact

invariants: Answer→decision→unblock is one logical commit, delivery is a separate acknowledged effect.
No answer to stale subject/options/revision, no second answer overwrite.
No per-session question count cap; hygiene may group duplicate obligations but cannot delete them.
failure_cases: Two questions on task, answer first → still blocked by second.
Question resolved by colleague while operator edits → stale_revision with current state, no overwritten answer.
Recipient execution ended after commit → continuation remains addressed to task/new admitted TaskRun, not last open terminal.
migration: Backfill blocker estate/project from both parents and quarantine invalid legacy links without rewriting journal. Replace apply_questions with deterministic recomputation compatible with @1; add v2 branch for explicit resolution id.
Keep legacy answered questions without decision_id as legacy_missing_decision, not fabricate an answer fact; UI indicates gap. New writes require atomic decision link.
Revoke direct table DML and raw guarded question answer events after all callers switch. M152.commit builds on this; M152.continue additionally consumes S04/M103.

Собирать macOS arm64 пакет на соответствующем runner. Smoke через тестовый profile + test estate + запрет scheduler auto-start; не наследовать userData/.env/default credentials. Проверить все типы окон и bridge внутри реально упакованного приложения.

Fresh P21 на 5051def красный: это open release gate S02, не доказанная утечка строк.

solution: Контрольный продуктовый цикл — fixture HTTP service с заранее внесённым дефектом; observer измеряет ответ, записывает observation, manager предлагает repair task, checker разрешает узкое изменение, worker исправляет, независимый process повторяет HTTP+regression probe и сохраняет receipt, manager обновляет решение/память и ставит следующий check.

Один corpus, одинаковые policy/context pins и два адаптера исполнителей; начать с Claude Code и Codex только после версии/capabilities conformance каждого. Сравнение делается по результату и вмешательствам, без переноса private session state.

Фиксировать safety как обязательный набор pass/fail, quality как явно оценённые критерии; cost/latency наблюдения, а не основания ослабить запрет. Seeded negative controls проверяют и executor, и judge.

items.title: Один полный рабочий цикл и второй исполнитель
items.why: Тесты хранения не доказывают продуктовый результат и переносимость агента.

solution: Сохранить estate как tenant boundary и owner/member как начальную минимальную модель. Identity берётся из проверенной auth-сессии на server-side command boundary, actor_id из renderer не принимается. Owner управляет membership/agent binding/grants; member читает дозволенное и создаёт/ведёт проектные задачи, но не выдаёт себе полномочий.

В v1 membership даёт estate-wide project visibility. Project-only/private memberships не имитировать фильтром renderer: это отдельная будущая capability; текущий owner/member интерфейс явно показывает estate scope.

Onboarding минимален: создать/выбрать estate → подключить или создать project/repository → проверить readiness выбранного исполнителя → создать первую задачу → открыть результат и receipt. Полная организация/все настройки не обязательны. Return journey начинается с addressed Inbox и изменений после lastSeen.

Revocation увеличивает membership revision и делает новые команды недопустимыми. Действующая команда повторно проверяет authority перед внешним dispatch; активная executor lease отменяется/ограничивается при отзыве. Уже выполненный эффект не стирается.
interfaces: ActorContext {person_id,estate_id,membership_role,membership_revision,session_expiry}; создан доверенным verifier, не IPC payload.

MembershipCommand {command_id,expected_revision,target_person_id,role:owner|member,action:invite|accept|revoke}; output {status:committed|conflict|refused,receipt_ref}. Invite: random single-use token hash only, expiry, intended identity, audited acceptance.

OnboardingState {estate_id?,project_id?,repo_status:absent|checking|ready|error,runner_status:unknown|checking|ready|unavailable,first_task_id?,last_completed_step}; settings persisted atomically per user.
invariants: Последнего owner нельзя отозвать; передача требует атомарного добавления нового owner.
Повтор invite accept с тем же command_id возвращает прежний receipt, не повторную membership.
Профиль человека не является источником authorization.
Funnel events являются локальными/estate operational observations, а не автоматической отправкой analytics наружу.
failure_cases: Revoke between read and write -> revision conflict; operation not executed.
Member accesses foreign estate through guessed task ID -> uniform scoped not_found/refused without object disclosure.
Two tabs accept invite -> one transaction wins, second idempotent result.
Failed runner setup keeps project/repo and entered instruction; retry readiness, not recreate project.
migration: Existing local owner is migrated only through verified account-link confirmation; never match people by display_name. Keep service identity separate from person membership.
User-facing invite/send needs recipient and delivery choice in implementation run; do not send invitations as part of this documentation change.
tests: Two synthetic authenticated identities: owner allowed grant, member denied same; after revoke old token denied even with cached UI.
Last-owner concurrent revoke -> both cannot succeed.
Onboarding fixture from empty and returning project; duplicate create click yields one project; result deep-link restored after restart.

items.title: Командный доступ и первый полезный результат
items.why: Видение командное, но доказательств двух живых пользователей пока нет.

solution: Две независимые правды: нормативное целевое устройство (this system-contract + domain dossiers + model JSON) и состояние реализации (code pins + probe receipts + backlog). Diagram генерируется из model JSON, а не редактируется отдельно. Per-card engineering catalog связывает каждую текущую карточку с контрактом/обоснованием/tests/files.

Уточнить термины WorkflowRun / TaskRun / Session / CycleInvocation / ExecutionAttempt / Iteration до реализации M188 и M194. Новые предлагаемые семантики записать в новых ADR; старые записи не править. Принятие новой ADR запускает propagation CONTEXT/architecture/schema examples/UX/contracts in one change.

Read statuses, execution statuses, decision claims и independent verification — разные типы. Запретить общий done как измерение проекта без источника. Exact event type IDs берутся из versioned registry, proposed IDs маркируются до регистрации.

Генератор карты и checker проверяют coverage, IDs, links, meaningful edge payloads, allowed lifecycle transitions, graph cycle exceptions, source fingerprints. Семантический review всё ещё обязателен: gate не понимает правильность бизнес-решения.

ImplementationEvidence {capability_id,design_status,implementation_status,verification_status,installation_status,observation_status,receipts[]}; no single averaged readiness score.
invariants: All57 source cards accounted for including shipped preserve rows; do not silently reimplement shipped foundations.
All proposed API/schema names labeled future; paths to create distinct from current evidence paths.
Rejected/pre-admission work is not a successful or failed runtime iteration.
failure_cases: Remove task from catalog -> coverage gate red.
Edit diagram without model -> generated-output parity red.
Unknown event claimed implemented -> source evidence check/review red.
migration: Introduce target design as explicit recommended baseline; implementation retains existing wire until versioned migration. Historical audit snapshots keep dates/source commit and link forward to current target.
tests: Run node scripts/check-system-model.mjs and builder --check; negative fixtures remove card, reference absent node/source and stale output -> fail.
Review every proposed semantic reversal against ADR0030/0042/0043/0041/0018 before marking accepted; implementation agents execute specified migration not choose ontology.

interfaces.RecoveryActivation: Command<{recoveryOperationId,expected_revision,verifiedArchiveDigest,currentAuthorityReceipt,reconciledIntentRefs,newEnvironmentId}> → CommandResult<{recoveryGeneration:Revision,activeCapabilities,heldCapabilities}>. Current trusted identity/control plane issues a fresh generation independent of the restored archive and fences old writers. Without current authority proof, restoration remains read-only. flow: Read scope from S02, obtain consistent snapshot and sourceCursor in one DB read transaction. Coverage explicitly lists assets/membership/goals/autonomy/agent bindings/human decisions+their relation pointers; unsupported entity is partial and blocks 'all declared restorable' claim.

Mirror writer renders deterministic allowlisted files to sibling temporary generation directory, fsync files, writes manifest LAST as generation commit marker, atomically replace manifest pointer; readers validate all hashes to avoid mixed generations. Existing user divergence preview before overwrite; no auto git commit/push.

Import v2 fully parse+schema validate+cross-ref validate+duplicate ID check+payload size bound before write. Server-side operation reserves scope+command key and rechecks target empty under estate lock. Execute bounded batch in ONE SQL transaction, append existing domain events needed to preserve status/settings/relations plus durable import receipt; crash beforecommit no partial estate. Larger archive returns IMPORT_TOO_LARGE with no writes, not silent chunk mode.

Legacy two-file import reads v1 with explicit partial coverage warning; uses same atomic command; cannot advertise restoration of absent goals/decisions. Path strings stay evidence; mappings checked local roots before executable use.

Restore journal, identity membership/role assignments, durable operational reservations/dedup/delivery/outbox/consent/suppression/cursors and required immutable blobs under a coherent snapshot. Restore is isolated, all dispatch/schedulers/export held. Old archive may predate rebind, opt-out or successful send: first obtain fresh recovery authority generation from the current trusted control plane and fence old environments; never trust restored grants or credential epochs as live authority. Reconcile possibly dispatched intents with provider receipts; unknown stays held. Reauthorize current membership, bindings and pending work through normal admission. Outbound consent resets off/quarantined; restored candidates/outbox never become sendable through activation alone; revalidate current suppression or retain quarantine. No current authority/suppression proof means read-only recovery, not success-by-default.

M198 scoped rebuild uses new projection generation/staging and parity check against live expected fixture, activation pointer last; other estates untouched. Failure leaves old generation readable and operation failed; rollback chooses previous generation, not undo journal history.
invariants: A target is empty for selected estate, not 'no projects anywhere'. Different estate rows neither block preview nor get exported.
Import status archived/done/settings/relations preserved through versioned semantics; never synthesize new IDs for matching existing entities.
No partial default fallback when manifest omitted/invalid; no imported filesystem path trusted as access grant.
Mirror sourceCursor advances only when committed manifest covering that snapshot exists; unrelated journal event seq is not mirror freshness.
Replay/projector never calls disk/network; operational receipts distinguish replay/rebuild from original live activation.

An older archive never revives permissions, a revoked binding, a consumed grant, acknowledged delivery or suppressed feedback. Recovery generation is issued outside restored state; reactivation is a separate guarded command, not a replay side effect.

solution.choice: DeliveryPort produces persisted delivery identity and explicit milestones: process_started, transport_ready, bytes_written, adapter_accepted, agent_accepted. Only correct invocation-scoped ack moves task to running; a prompt heuristic cannot substitute. Native session reuse is available only when adapter can bind each invocation to task_run_id and fence.
states: queued → waiting_ready → written_unconfirmed → accepted; waiting_ready → failed_before_write; written_unconfirmed → outcome_unknown on timeout/disconnect, not automatically resent.
cancel_requested blocks future writes; written command requires receiver cancellation ack/observed invocation end before cancelled.
Task attached is a relation, not confirmation. agent_accepted is an agent claim received by Fabric, not proof of understanding or success.
transactions: Create delivery_id and instruction_digest/inputRef atomically with TaskRun launch outbox. Structured adapter receives envelope with task_run_id,delivery_id,run fence,protocol_revision and input_ref. Ack must match all and come through that run-scoped credential; duplicate same ack returns original receipt, different digest/recipient refuses.

Reuse live native session only after previous TaskRun terminal and old credential fenced; new invocation gets new delivery_id/TaskRun/credential. Crash retry of queued delivery safe only before write proven; unknown write requires lookup/ack or operator inspection.

Legacy PTY preserves bracketed-paste encoding, but silence/deadline is only a readiness hint. After one write return unconfirmed and expose inspect/explicit resend new-intent action. Do not queue a second prompt automatically on timeout; pending deliveries cannot overwrite each other.
solution.continuation: An answered question resolves a task-addressed continuation. If original TaskRun is active and adapter supports addressed resume, deliver within that invocation; if it ended, S04 admits a new TaskRun pinned to resolution input. Never deliver to selected/latest terminal.

schema: deliveries {delivery_id PK,estate_id,project_id,task_id,task_run_id,fabric_session_id?,binding_revision,lease_epoch,input_ref,input_digest,protocol_revision,state,queued_seq,written_seq?,ack_seq?,deadline_at}; UNIQUE(task_run_id,delivery_kind,source_command_id)
delivery_ack {delivery_id UNIQUE,task_run_id,recipient_ref,input_digest,accepted_seq,source:agent|adapter|operator}; adapter ack never promoted to agent ack
commands: fabric_task_accept({deliveryId,inputDigest,protocolRevision}) → accepted receipt; task/run taken from scope

invariants: No bytes-written event without writer result; no agent-accepted event without matching acknowledgement.
Slow startup/timeout never silently changes target or doubles prompt.
Provider-native session id never authorizes delivery to another TaskRun.
failure_cases: No output until deadline → policy explicit legacy write once/unconfirmed or required structured mode waits, never accepted.
Malformed ack and old-session late ack → refusal, current task untouched.
Early process exit before write → failed_before_write; after write → unknown delivery with observed exit.
migration: Keep asOnePaste and existing terminal methods for manual terminal use, route managed task delivery through DeliveryPort.
Add capability flags structured_ready/task_ack/invocation_reuse separately; default legacy adapters false.
Existing attached sessions read delivery=legacy_unconfirmed unless evidence exists. No retrospective acknowledgement from transcript or nonempty output.

solution.choice: Preserve v1 displayed revision semantics (initial1 + number of legacy config-changing events), but derive absolute revision from journal prefix rather than mutable projection state. Future config reference adds event_seq+snapshot_hash to remove ambiguous historical labels.
algorithm: For first project.created@1 assign revision1. For legacy config events at seq S assign 1+COUNT(effective project.updated@1/project.settings.updated@1 events for this estate/project from its first valid create through S), not current row+1. A duplicate legacy create also assigns the prefix-derived absolute value, not an accidental reset. Ordered replay over existing rows converges. Orphan pre-create updates are diagnosed and not counted as effective changes. Add scoped partial index for the legacy prefix query.

For new config commands, transaction validates expected revision and emits project.configuration.changed@2 with absolute next_revision, previous_ref and canonical snapshot_hash. Projector assigns the recorded number/snapshot, never recomputes from current mutable projection. Legacy-to-v2 cutoff per project is explicit; later legacy guarded config writes disabled.

ConfigRef={project_id,revision,event_seq,snapshot_hash}; run pins this immutable ref. A numerical legacy revision that drifted due rebuild is retained as legacy_display_revision only, not presumed an exact snapshot identity.

schema: project_config_versions projection {estate_id,project_id,revision,event_seq,snapshot_hash,snapshot}; UNIQUE(project_id,revision), UNIQUE(estate_id,event_seq,project_id)

migration reconciliation receipt {project_id,legacy_observed_revision,canonical_revision,source_event_seq,mapping_quality:exact|unverifiable}
interfaces.serialization: Public config_revision is opaque Revision string through common serializer. Internal prefix-derived numeric bigint remains SQL arithmetic; no client arithmetic or unsafe Number conversion.

invariants: Two rebuilds identical incl config_revision; no replay increments.
A revision pin cannot silently retarget to another snapshot.
S02 scope validates event project matches aggregate before new config writes.
failure_cases: Existing project revision inflated by previous rebuild → canonical correction plus retained legacy label; no invented historical mapping.
Two config updates same expected revision → onecommit, otherstale.
Late replay event cannot increment beyond prefix-derived revision; out-of-order projection application is refused by projection cursor, full replay ordered.
migration: New append-only migration replaces only per-concern projector; keep M97 dispatcher shape. Backfill canonical revisions from journal and capture before/after mapping once.

Return config_revision to P24 snapshots; expand parity set to new config_versions when added. Validate historical persisted references before conversion; references without supporting seq/hash remain explicitly unverified.
Existing renderer uses revision for refresh and display; preserve positive integer and add structured refs without silently changing wire type.

solution: Разделить terminal display ring, incremental tail parser и durable transcript stream. onData делает O(chunk size) обработку; запрещены regex/split всего scrollback на каждый chunk. UI sessions.list возвращает summary без scrollback; terminal subscriber получает bounded snapshot once then sequence-numbered chunks.

Tail parser — streaming state machine text/ESC/CSI/OSC/OSC_ESC, сохраняет незавершённую escape sequence между chunks; CR обновляет текущую строку, LF завершает, ordinary [link] сохраняется. Raw transcript хранит исходные bytes отдельно; display text не source transcript.

Async persistence batching: queue byte counter, 64KiB flush threshold или 50ms, final flush awaited before transcript-complete receipt. Это проектные начальные limits, не измеренный оптимум. At 4MiB pending apply upstream PTY pause if supported; otherwise keep durable spool and mark overload, never silently drop data or block main with sync I/O.

Terminal capture error marks transcript incomplete with offset/error; independent execution status persists. UTF-8 decoder state does not split multibyte codepoints. Limit tail text to120 Unicode codepoints after ANSI decode, not bytes.
interfaces: SessionSummary {session_id,status,tail,tail_seq,transcript_state:capturing|complete|incomplete,last_output_at}; no scrollback.
TerminalSnapshot {session_id,from_seq,to_seq,text,truncated}; TerminalChunk {session_id,seq,data}; TranscriptRange {session_id,offset_bytes,limit_bytes} -> {bytes,next_offset,complete,sha256?}.
invariants: No full transcript in periodic all-sessions query.
Exit observed and transcript persisted are separate receipts; flush failure cannot erase process exit.
Truncation of display ring does not truncate durable transcript without explicit incomplete state.

Queue write error/ENOSPC -> incomplete and actionable notification; output not reported fully saved.
Burst then immediate exit -> completion receipt emitted only after flush.
Remote runner with no pause/spool contract -> capability unavailable, bounded loss is explicit not hidden.

solution.choice: Heartbeat is an authenticated, run-bound positive claim with server receipt time. Persist one monotonic agent sequence per task invocation/generation; old messages cannot revive old execution. Separate reported phase, observed transport/process activity and derived liveness.
states: phase enum reading/working/waiting/verifying/blocked, independently receivedAt and process state. waiting_on only valid for waiting/blocked and only current scoped question/grant/continuation.
derived liveness working/waiting/quiet/stalled/gone plus observation coverage available/unsupported/unobserved. stalled means suspicion based on gap, never proven wedged cause.
duplicate beat returns prior receipt without refreshing last_received_at; lower beat_seq is stale; same seq with changed payload conflicts.
transactions: heartbeat({beatSeq,phase,note?,waitingOn?}) takes task_run_id/fabric_session_id/role_slot_id/binding_revision/epoch from credential. Lock current run/heartbeat row, verify active invocation and current fence, validate waiting object scope/state, append agent.heartbeat@1 with receive timestamp from DB and projection update only if seq advances.

On newly resolved waiting object, liveness cannot remain permanently waiting on old self-report; state records wait target resolved, grace starts from resolution receipt, await next beat/work observation. Policy thresholds/cadence are resolved/pinned from estate settings + runner capability; validate stall_after>=quiet_after>=expected_interval and positive bounds.
solution.time: DB/server receivedAt is authority for durable ordering; client sentAt optional diagnostic only. Local watchdog uses monotonic elapsed clock and host sleep intervals to avoid wall-clock jump errors. An unsupported beat capability is declared, not silently assigned a universal 60-second fault threshold.

solution.choice: Observer runs outside agent and independently of the PTY dispatch event queue. Use a dedicated worker event loop for main-loop responsiveness/monotonic host sampling; process identity includes PID+birth/start fingerprint+host_generation. Its bounded spool remains able to report DB/main-loop unavailability; no perpetual daemon is introduced.
detectors: Orientation unconfirmed: no successful/recorded protocol delivery within grace. Existing session.oriented@1 is only request-side evidence; append may fail while rules are delivered and may precede response completion. Classify unconfirmed, not skill-failed.
Agent signal gap with host and transport known healthy → stalled_suspected; recent valid heartbeat plus long silence → quiet/working, not fault.
Observed invocation/process exit → runtime ended. Exit0 does not prove task result success. PID reuse must not resurrect task invocation.
Host suspend/resume/main-loop-unresponsive or DB outage → observation gap on host/source; suppress agent-specific blame until observer reacquires fresh evidence.
transactions: Condition occurrence key {task_run_id,detector_kind,condition_generation}; transition healthy→suspected appends one finding. Repeated unchanged sample updates observation age without creating duplicate Board obligation. recovery appends resolution receipt to same occurrence.

On restart, reconcile only runs owned by this host generation and expired leases. Query provider/supervisor by task_run_id; positive alive matching fingerprint may reattach under explicit supported profile. No evidence → outcome_unknown/recovery_required; do not mark all running tasks cancelled merely because app restarted. Remote/other-host runs untouched.
solution.limits: Worker shares app lifetime; if whole app is dead no online observer exists. Show last_observed_at on next launch. An independent hosted monitor would be a new placement/profile, not implied by this worker.

Condition dedupe key stable through restart; repeated polling does not spam Board.
Run terminal state never fabricated from output silence or startup.
failure_cases: Main eventloop stalled but worker responsive → host_loop_unresponsive, not agent_wedged.
DB outage while process alive → data_source_unavailable and gap, task still not classified success/failure.
Host dies, PID reused by another process → mismatched fingerprint, no reattach.

solution.choice: Resolve contradictory ADR grain explicitly in a NEW proposed ADR: WorkflowRun preserves0030 graph walk and existing run_id wire; TaskRun is a new canonical task_run_id for one admitted explicit task invocation. fabric_session_id/native_session_ref are separate and may span sequential TaskRuns only through a verified adapter. entities: WorkflowRun pins graph declaration version, config/binding/provider/policy/engine refs, budget and cancellation context. Rendered graphs are queries; immutable graph/plan definitions and event receipts are allowed, not a second mutable visualization graph.

Every explicit task evaluation loop pass creates fresh TaskRun after admission, with new plan/step state. A denied admission is no run. Transport retry/LLM hidden internal turn is Attempt/unknown-internal-work, not another TaskRun.

PlanRevision immutable within TaskRun: plan_revision_id, revision_no, supersedes_plan_revision_id, reason, total_known, step definitions. StepId stable across replans only for same semantic operation; changed operation new stepId with supersedes reference.

Step claims and verification observations independent. Plan can support parallel sibling steps/dependency DAG and nested parent steps; parent progress derived from child receipts and never a second mutable number.
states: TaskRun runtime terminal once ended; result/verification evidence may arrive later as linked assessment, never rewrite terminal runtime receipt. WorkflowRun terminal state immutable; continuation new WorkflowRun with predecessor_ref.

StepClaim planned→active|skipped; active→blocked|done|failed|skipped; blocked→active|failed|skipped; terminal claim within that plan revision not reopened. Corrected work declares new revision/step or next TaskRun. done is agent claim; verification pass/fail/not_run/unknown has separate source.

Replan atomically activates new plan revision via expected_current_revision CAS. Old definitions and claims freeze for current-view purposes. Same-run carryover of completed step allowed only with explicit carryover_ref and unchanged inputs/operation; fresh TaskRun always resets all steps.

Wake-worthy event class registry ignores heartbeat/tool trace/checkpoint and self-only maintenance; consume each eligible source event once. A worker result sharing causal root is eligible; no blanket suppression of all descendants. Bound chain hop/iteration and total model/time/cost budget independently.
solution.time_policy: Interval routines use UTC interval origin and coalesce_missed_once. Calendar letters use timezone + calendar day key with preserved one-per-day windows; catchup each bounded by max starts per poll. Persist DST policy: nonexistent local trigger→next valid time; ambiguous→first occurrence, one logical window. Record calculated UTC bounds and tzdb/runtime version. If policy changes, new definition revision; never reinterpret old window keys.
solution.app_off: A disabled/offline host cannot produce new health receipts. Last observer timestamp and reason remain visible. No always-on claim; next launch processes explicit catch-up. Unknown crash gap cannot be labeled confirmed app closed. Diagnostic source-down overlay is separate from business success.

parts.why: Продолжать разрешённую работу без ручного выбора при приближении лимита, как cswap, сохраняя границы разговора и бюджета.

solution.entry: Current backlog; prerequisites below provide typed input contracts.
flow: Хранить versioned opt-in policy с account allowlist, provider/runtime/project scope, conversation enrollment/pin, threshold, best/consume-first, model windows, hysteresis, cooldown и hard switch cap. Включение разрешает последующие смены без второго confirmation.

Вынести pure decision engine: свежая типизированная usage → eligible candidates → deterministic stay/switch/hold decision с причиной. best выбирает headroom, consume-first — ближайший weekly reset у пригодных аккаунтов. consume-first может переключить до порога на аккаунт с более ранним подтверждённым weekly reset и достаточным запасом; best в этом случае остаётся.

Перед остановкой повторно проверить identity, quota, policy/membership/binding revisions. Dedup tick/intent на conversation и observation; использовать M199.resume, не отдельный global credential switch.

Сохранить cooldown/quarantine/exclusions/pending operation и backoff через рестарт. Один tick lease на scope; bounded adaptive polling, Retry-After и exhausted reset scheduling. App-off останавливает loop.

Pause/disable до stop снимает queued intent; после stop только recovery. Manual pin исключает conversation. Unknown usage не разрешает blind fallback, invalid refresh quarantines account, billed/API-key account требует отдельного явного допуска.
Не сбрасывать бюджет, дедлайн и суммарное число попыток при новом account/TaskRun; hard cap действует и при 100% quota. Preview/dry-run проходит тот же selector без credential/PTY mutation.
solution.exit: Не сбрасывать бюджет, дедлайн и суммарное число попыток при новом account/TaskRun; hard cap действует и при 100% quota. Preview/dry-run проходит тот же selector без credential/PTY mutation.

common_contract.boundary: Read-only source/CI-log research. No live DB queries, migrations, native app, agents or full tests were run. File receipts describe existing code; interfaces and tests below are proposed.

vocabulary.name: WorkflowRun
vocabulary.key: workflow_run_id UUID; legacy journal.run_id retains this grain
vocabulary.meaning: One admitted execution of an immutable graph version/as-of declaration. Owns total budget, cancel and durable engine/build pins. 1:N node occurrences, 1:N TaskRuns. Ad-hoc single task may have workflow_run_id=null; do not fabricate a graph parent.
vocabulary.cardinality: Routine 1:N WorkflowRun; WorkflowRun 1:1 graph_version; WorkflowRun 1:N NodeOccurrence; node occurrence 1:N launch TaskRuns across retries.

vocabulary.name: TaskRun
vocabulary.key: task_run_id UUID is canonical; existing fabric_session_id and provider-native ref are separate
vocabulary.meaning: One admitted explicit logical task invocation/evaluation. Rejection before admission creates no TaskRun. Failed spawn after admission creates a TaskRun with failed_start. Default CLI opens fresh PTY; a verified adapter may reuse native session only with invocation-specific ack/trace/fence. Every explicit evaluation iteration gets new TaskRun and fresh steps, even if native session is reused.
vocabulary.cardinality: Task 1:N TaskRun; TaskRun 0..1 WorkflowRun/NodeOccurrence; TaskRun 0..1 fabric/native session reference; one session may host sequential TaskRuns only with admitted capability. Default 0..1 active TaskRun per task; ended task never reopens.

vocabulary.name: LoopIteration
vocabulary.meaning: An explicitly orchestrated loop pass, with input watermark/budget/checkpoint. A pass that launches work creates new TaskRun(s); a deterministic pass may create zero. Native hidden LLM/tool turns do not invent visible Fabric loop iterations.

vocabulary.name: Attempt
vocabulary.meaning: A concrete transport/provider/effect try, correlated to command and optionally TaskRun. A repeated RPC with same key returns its original receipt. A new logical task evaluation or relaunch after ended/failed TaskRun requires a new admitted TaskRun; hidden provider turns are not guessed as iterations.

vocabulary.name: NativeSessionRef
vocabulary.meaning: Optional provider-owned thread/session id. Never use as Fabric authority, primary Run key, cross-provider portability guarantee or evidence of task acceptance.

common_contract.wire_migration: Keep existing run_id as WorkflowRun graph grain and all @1 payload semantics. CorrelationV2 adds task_run_id, workflow_run_id, fabric_session_id, node_occurrence_id, loop_iteration_ref, attempt_id, command_id, causation_id. Provider execution/session ref is namespaced and opaque. A NEW proposed ADR formally qualifies ADR0042 pair/no-new-id: task_run_id exists before OS spawn and a native session can host multiple sequential explicit task invocations only via verified adapter. No operator acceptance or ADR reservation implied. Legacy task/session pair mapping is read-only migration evidence; never silently reinterpret run_id.
transactions: Single business source: journal events; projections are rebuildable. Typed command ingress validates domain invariants and commits events + receipt atomically. Existing per-estate advisory transaction lock supplies initial serialization; no network/PTY calls while holding it. Locks acquired estate → sorted aggregate IDs → grant/budget/lease; lock timeout yields retryable not accepted.

Use private append primitive and public typed RPCs for guarded mutation types. Revoke direct service_role DML on migrated authority/run/question projections; public append_event wrapper refuses those types. Typed SECURITY DEFINER RPC calls the same private primitive, pins search_path to pg_catalog and explicitly qualifies app tables; revoke execution from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated. Main is the trusted local server, not an agent token. This preserves one writer without leaving a generic append bypass around the new guards.

command_requests/receipts: UNIQUE(estate_id,command_id); command_kind and canonical typed input participate in payload_hash. command_id is the single caller-persisted idempotency identity, not a newly generated ID on retries. Persist principal/subject scope, safe result_json and event seq refs. Authenticate/current scope first; duplicate receipt access requires permitted subject before returning prior result. Same ID+hash returns original result across authorized retry/role handoff; changed hash yields refused payload_mismatch. Stale expected revision yields the shared conflict result. A database/network timeout may have committed: shared status unknown with request_id=command_id; lookup same ID before retry. Only proven no-commit yields unavailable. Policy refusal does not retry automatically after changed conditions; a new intentional command gets a new ID.

Leases/fences, outbox and receipt ledgers are orchestration control state, not a second copy of tasks/Board. Acquisition/revocation/dispatch/checkpoints have journal receipts and rebuildable projections. Never mint epoch from replay count; carry assigned epoch in events. Runtime credentials bind epoch and host generation; rebuild cannot revive a dead host or revoke history. Expiry comparison uses server time; serializing commands prevents concurrent conflicting claims.

Domain receipt durability is mandatory for mutation. Diagnostic trace delivery is separately bounded: a trace gap cannot fabricate domain success, nor may an optional diagnostic sink invalidate an already committed mutation. Redact before every persistence/log/notification sink; do not hash or log bearer tokens as identifiers.

Exactly-once local logical commit is possible with database uniqueness. External side effects remain at-least-once dispatch with target idempotency/reconciliation. Unknown outcome retains reservation and creates a specific attention item; no automatic new idempotency key. Cancellation stops future dispatch, never rewrites completed effects.
common_contract.rollout: Add schema/functions and deterministic replay tests first; dual-read legacy + v2, then switch all callers of one guarded command family together, then revoke legacy writes for that family. Do not enable automatic launches on migration alone. Startup verifies minimum schema/command version and refuses writes with upgrade-required; source archive/history is not a runtime prerequisite. No rollback that reopens old authority after v2 effects: roll forward or read-only.
common_contract.profiles: ADR0022 remains accepted: local DB queue is the short/effect-free development profile until its recovery fixtures pass. Managed Temporal remains reference adapter, not part of this task to install. Port records engine kind/build/id only when actually bound. Local app-off executes nothing; recovery resumes on next observed host start. A stronger durable SLA is a separately admitted profile.

external_sources.use: SQL privileges and row-level visibility are distinct checks.
Owner/BYPASSRLS identity matters; service-role scoping cannot be delegated to RLS.
Do not infer init/default grants across environment versions; pin and record actual CLI/image/catalog.

common_contract.roles: Canonical leadership roles are ceo at estate scope and product-manager at project scope; manager is UI wording, not a third role enum. RoleSlot={role_slot_id,estate_id,project_id:null|UUID,role}; UNIQUE estate CEO slot / project PM slot; immutable binding_revision and monotonic role_epoch. TaskRun lease includes role_slot_id (when applicable), binding_revision and role_epoch plus task lease epoch/host_generation. Current schema requires agent_bindings.project_id, so estate CEO scope needs explicit versioned schema before activation. Actor.kind stays person|agent|system; leadership role never becomes an actor kind by accident.

system_contract_alignment.public_types: Command, CommandResult, ReadEnvelope, VerifiedContext, Seq, Revision and Ref above are copied verbatim from the current common system-contract target. No second generic CommandResult is defined.
mappings: Earlier research notation Scope means internal RuntimeVerifiedContext, whose public base is VerifiedContext. project_id:null is SQL storage representation of estate scope; public scope is discriminated {kind:estate} or {kind:project,project_id}. No nullable project shorthand crosses the public boundary.

Every command signature listed under a card is its typed input/value, wrapped as Command<Input> -> CommandResult<Value>. Private helpers may be camelCase; public command fields command_id/expected_revision/input stay the common snake_case envelope. A key/idempotencyKey mentioned in algorithm prose is exactly Command.command_id, not an extra independently minted token.
ScopedResult and ReadSnapshot notation is replaced with ReadEnvelope. No empty arrays substitute for unavailable reads; omitted/coverage/at_seq come from actual query evidence.

A domain state named outcome_unknown (effect, delivery, cycle) is data persisted under its own state machine. If command commit is ambiguous it maps to CommandResult.status=unknown/request_id=command_id. A committed command recording a domain unknown returns status=committed plus that domain value. Do not collapse these two kinds of uncertainty.

Public Revision is opaque equality string; DB numeric revision counters may be bigint internally, encoded by one versioned serializer. Seq/epoch are decimal strings on JSON wire. Client never increments either.

Existing task ladder is closed: backlog/running/review/done/cancelled. No blocked rung; terminal task continuation creates new linked Task. Runtime terminal receipts and later business acceptance remain separate.

Checkpoint in system model means gate check/verdict. ExecutionSnapshot below means durable resume/cursor snapshot; it carries no approval. A checkpoint verdict may refer to an execution_snapshot_id, but saving a snapshot cannot authorize a gate.

Feedback lineage private in authoritative operational events/projections; external DTO explicitly excludes source IDs/paths/free text. Suppression keyed stable lineage family, survives category/revision/privacySchema changes.

Local intake toggling и outbound policy независимы. Outbound optout increments epoch and atomically cancels eligible pending; dispatcher rechecks before send and records started. Inflight already handed to OS cannot be promised unsent.
Provider ACK lost→delivery unknown; retry only endpoint idempotency guarantee+same key, otherwise reconcile/manual. Sent is recipient ACK, not local HTTP attempt.
Re-enable starts at current cursor/new epoch, no historical backfill absent separate preview+authorized command.

Local erase of feedback content, suppression receipt retention, previous remote retention/deletion — отдельные состояния. Нельзя обещать erase из immutable source journal; memory.forget requires own approved content-purge contract. Suppression tombstone сохраняет минимальный non-content key, срок по принятому retention policy.
One active binding per slot and one active execution lease per slot epoch; slot semantic key unique scope+role. Configured active role required by governance, runtime online may be false/unknown.

Manager pack estate exposes cross-project summaries allowed by role; project tools require explicit authorized target project, not unrestricted null project. Person remains effects/policy owner; agent never approves own promotion/checker change.
Fence checked by authoritative DB transaction at every mutation, not renderer/MCP token mint only. Old epoch invalid even with valid token and delayed response.

Handoff persists replacement revision+epoch fence before shutdown wait; old grants revoked; old already-dispatched outside effects separately unknown/reconcile. Only pending decisions/context/mailbox references transferred, not hidden reasoning.
Manager invocation is management work without fake task. If manager creates task, it passes normal command+admission service; admitted child TaskRun gets proper ID later.

Native provider controls may prevent native tools, but Fabric guarantees authoritative changes only via its tools. Runtime admission requires certified pinned runner profile; unsupported capability blocks external manager, not ordinary human terminal availability.

Все карточки импортируют Command<T>, CommandResult<T>, VerifiedContext, Seq, Revision, Ref и ReadEnvelope<T> из общего package, который материализует system-contract. Приведённые доменные DTO описывают Command.input / CommandResult.value / ReadEnvelope.data либо операционное состояние; не альтернативный transport envelope.
command_mapping: commandId→command_id; expectedRevision→expected_revision. Поля scope/actor/policyRevision/bindingRevision/epoch из trusted context, не payload. basisCursor/previewdigest/policyprofile являются domaininput, не вторым genericmeta.

Рекомендуемые camelCase имена внутренних pure functions не задают второй wire: IPC/MCP/SQL boundary имеет snake_case поля общего контракта. Domain DTO serialization фиксируется schema и conformance roundtrip; актор не принимается от producer.

Повтор с тем же canonical payload возвращает status=committed с исходным receipt_ref; already_committed не новый wirestatus. repeated=true может быть необязательной диагностикой receipt, не результатом бизнес-команды.

Ранее domain rejected/invalid → top-level refused с закрытым modulecode. CAS→conflict(current_revision). Known no commit/dispatch→unavailable. Возможный commit/dispatch→unknown и reconcile_after_ms. Не использовать unavailable для ambiguous transporttimeout.

Dedup строго (estate_id,command_id) как в system-contract. Canonical hash покрывает input+command type+trusted principal identity; при иной principal/payload refusal/conflict без утечки чужого receipt. Получить старый result может только тот, кто вправе его читать.
receipt_ref ведёт на CommandReceipt, где находятся commit_seq:Seq и domainvalue refs. Domainoperation status/retry state читается из value/data; не из второй generic оболочки.
read_mapping: Domain ScopedRead<T>={request_key:{scope_ref,generation,filter_hash},snapshot:ReadEnvelope<T>}; request_key — correlating wrapper от доверенного adapter, scope всё равно проверяетserver. Именно он обеспечивает lateA→B fencing, которого generic envelope не кодирует.
value→data; complete→availability complete; partial→partial; failed→unavailable. Последнее относится availability; failed может остаться статусом конкретной import/compile operation в data.

source ready→sources.status ok; source unavailable→error; not_configured→not_configured; unsupported→not_supported. Stale — общий freshness или per-source evidence metadata внутри data, не пятый sources.status.

readAt/lastSuccessAt разделить: envelope.as_of=время фактически измеренного snapshot, request completion timestamp отдельный source/domainreceipt. cursor.seq→at_seq; source projection version→revision либо domain generation_ref. mixed snapshots explicitly data.consistency=mixed, не fabricatedsnapshot.
omittedKnown→omitted[{count:number|null,reason}], nextCursor→next_cursor. Source-specific cursor/history details хранятся в data.source_receipts, не конкурирующей generic source schema.

Seq/at_seq/epoch/watermarks сериализуются decimal string, не Number. Revision — opaque equality token, не arithmetic UI. SQL bigint comparisons native, pureinternal BigInt only with explicit losslessadapter.
